notes.logRoot: folder (relative to the repo root) holding one folder per moveMode, each with Test_N folders
notes.testFolderPrefix: each run is logged to <logRoot>/<moveMode>/<testFolderPrefix><N>, N counting up
notes.currentEgo: measured motor angles from the STM32 (rad), A..F
notes.desiredGlob: target tool-tip pose [x, y, z, Rx, Ry, Rz] (mm, rad)
notes.calculatedGlob: tool-tip pose the active model predicts for its last command (one row behind the command)
notes.configParams: configuration-space target [k1, r1, s1, k2, r2, s2] (1/mm, rad, mm). File name kept from before the rename so old logs still load
notes.limitsHit: PCC limit clamps [s1, s2, bend1, bend2] as 0/1
notes.testInfo: run settings as 'key = value' lines, written at the start of the run
